excerpt.zh: 下方星球上的著名餐饮区已同意接待乘客，为他们举办一场由向导带领的当地美食品鉴之旅。
excerpt.en: The renowned dining districts on the planet below have agreed to host the passengers for a guided tasting tour of local cuisine.
